card.title: IPad Not Charging Battery Always Reporting 1 Percent Charge

source.title: IPad Not Charging Battery Always Reporting 1 Percent Charge

claims.statement: iPads stuck at 1%, not charging and restarting (TG0B/TG0V in panic logs) usually have a battery fault or poor battery-to-board connection.
A missing or wrong-length battery connector screw causes it; most iPads use a 1.8–2.3 mm Phillips screw; overtightening can lift the FPC side pins.

The battery FPC on the board is often damaged by tools pushed in to disconnect the battery; it is shared across groups: iPad Air/Air 2/iPad 5–9; iPad Air 3/Air 4/Pro 10.5/Pro 11 1st–3rd/Pro 12.9 1st, 3rd–6th (5-pin); Pro 9.7/Pro 12.9 2nd.

procedure: Inspect and probe the battery FPC.
Replace the FPC (low-melt solder, clean holes).
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Overtightening the battery screw can bend the FPC and lift pins.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
